title: ADHD vs Non-ADHD Paying One Bill 😂 When My ADHD Gets Me in Trouble #shorts
description:
When my ADHD gets me in trouble: a two-minute bill, an all-day job.

Opened the laptop to pay one bill. 40 tabs later, still not paid. Late fee: $35. 😂 What's YOUR two-minute task that takes all day? 👇

Tip: turn on autopay for anything with a due date.
